mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered discount rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) declines by > 0.5pp in 2 months, signaling labor market strength, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE declines > 0.5pp in 2mo, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, indicating supply chain strength, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to improved business sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when INDPRO > 6mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL), indicating managed inflation, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to balanced monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 9% signals a labor market turnaround, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 9% in post-shock recovery, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by > 100K in a month, signaling supply chain resilience, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved business sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 100K in 1mo, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
